content:
anya: Quick follow-up on attr handling RFC. Two live options: gateway attr-eviction vs per-tenant partitioning. short takes?

mike: Eviction = simpler + cheaper. Partitioning = accurate billing and less noisy-query blast, but ops heavy.

tariq: We had a customer support incident when billing.customer_id got evicted; billing showed as unknown for hours. accuracy matters for hot tenants.

lucy: Noisy tenants with many high-cardinality attrs blow up analytics. Dedicated partitions contain that.

anya: Ops risk: partitioning multiplies shards/streams and complicates autoscaling. can't let cost run away.

mike: Proposal: hybrid. Keep a minimal pinned attr set at gateway, evict everything else; detect "noisy" tenants and route top-N into dedicated partitions.

tariq: Define pinned set: [billing.customer_id, billing.key, tenant.id, service.name, env]. Enforce at proto validation and flag missing rather than drop.

lucy: +1. Soft-flag missing attrs so traces remain searchable and we alert owners. Also cap extra attrs per event (eg max_other_attrs=30).

anya: Example gateway config snippet: ```
eviction.pinned_attrs=["billing.customer_id","tenant.id","service.name","env"]
eviction.max_other_attrs=30
eviction.missing_policy=flag
routing.partition_tps_threshold=1500
routing.dedicated_top_n=25
```
mike: Routing key: tenant.id + billing.key. Cross-partition queries handled by fanout+merge at admin layer only; avoid for low-latency SLOs.

tariq: Spike plan: instrument noisy-tenant detector (cardinality + ingestion TPS), implement pinned-attr enforcement + soft-flag, prototype routing for top-25. Collect cost & fidelity deltas.

ingest-bot: Spike created by @anya -> obs/ingest/attr-hybrid-spike (https://phab.redwood/EVCT-314).

anya: Action owners: mike+tariq spike (3 days), lucy will produce billing evals, I'll update RFC with hybrid recommendation after numbers.

lucy: I'll run attribution test set and post false-negative rates.

mike: ack, will post spike results here. :thumbsup:
